title: Purchasing Management and Cost Saving Techniques
overview: Managing a 21st-century purchasing department comes with its own set of challenges. In today's globalized economy, purchasing professionals must navigate complex supplier relationships, often spanning across continents, while still driving cost savings. This course focuses on how to effectively manage suppliers and align the purchasing function with overall supply chain operations. Participants will learn techniques to optimize departmental management, ensure supplier performance, and meet key performance indicators (KPIs).
audience: This course is ideal for buyers, senior buyers, purchasing supervisors, purchasing managers, and anyone involved in or looking to understand the purchasing function.
methodology: Participants will engage in a variety of interactive learning tools, including round table discussions, role-playing, case studies, and both individual and group exercises.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the strategic role of the purchasing department
Formulate effective negotiation strategies with suppliers
Recognize the importance of value analysis in purchasing decisions
Measure departmental performance using appropriate KPIs
Enhance the efficiency and productivity of the purchasing department
